title: Qwen Chat Mock
subtitle: Disrupting Traditional Traffic Models: Building a Value-Driven Growth Flywheel Centered on User Value

mainContent.content: This project aims to disrupt the traditional DAU traffic model and build a value-driven growth flywheel centered on user value. Through multi-modal intelligent continuous input, users are empowered with real-time control over AI-generated content, efficiently transforming fragmented user intentions into digital assets. Ultimately, mobile devices are upgraded from inefficient tools to cross-platform intention controllers, making AI an extension of the user's mind and a value amplifier.

Core Features (High Fidelity Mock):
- Instant Feedback: Provides complete content in real-time through semi-transparent, non-intrusive display.
- Silent Efficient Input: Supports multiple input modalities including text, voice, and app navigation.
- Context Editor View: Automatically enters specific context after recognizing generation commands, using silent modalities like cursor and browsing context to provide predictive content.
- Controllable Behavior: Users can intervene and interrupt streaming output at any time through voice or other means.
- Proactive Service: Transitions from passive response to proactive service using online reinforcement learning models.
- Information Alignment Compression: Compresses complex instructions and long contexts into semantic anchors.

Core Design Thinking:
- From Passive Waiting to Active Control: Inspired by Cursor Tab, elevating content filling interaction to a higher dimension.
- Creating Flow Experience: Using online reinforcement learning models to capture user intentions and automatically bridge gaps between tasks.
- Intelligent Continuity: Not just predicting the next word, but connecting conceptual leaps.
- Semantic Zoom: Inspired by Sensecape, addressing challenges in cross-device collaboration and long-context tracking.
